name: ios-ui-ux-reviewer
title: iOS UI/UX 审查师
job_to_be_done: Review an existing iOS app's UI, UX, interaction, and accessibility from Xcode, SwiftUI, or UIKit source, optionally verifying flows in a simulator. Use for iOS UI审查、UX审查、交互审查、界面审查 and actionable design findings with code locations. Exclude pure build repair, backend review, Android/web design, new screen implementation, and ASO keyword work.

trigger_surface.description: Review an existing iOS app's UI, UX, interaction, and accessibility from Xcode, SwiftUI, or UIKit source, optionally verifying flows in a simulator. Use for iOS UI审查、UX审查、交互审查、界面审查 and actionable design findings with code locations. Exclude pure build repair, backend review, Android/web design, new screen implementation, and ASO keyword work.
should_trigger: 读取 Xcode 工程，做一次 UI审查，给修改建议
Review the UI and UX of my existing SwiftUI app
帮我检查 iOS App 的交互问题，先不要改代码
审查 UIKit 页面的无障碍问题，只有源码也先检查
审查 iOS 付费页，判断交互和价格展示是否误导
iOS UI审查，只看截图，不运行模拟器
should_not_trigger: 帮我修复 SwiftUI 编译错误
优化 App Store 关键词
edge_cases: 启动 iOS 模拟器并截一张图
审查网站的 UI 和 UX
实现一个新的 SwiftUI 登录页面
检查 iOS 项目的后端 SQL 性能

steps: Read repository instructions and status. Resolve project, target, versions, language, and scope.
Follow [workflow](references/workflow.md) and [report contract](references/report-contract.md). Map screens, navigation, shared controls, and states.
Select [audit matrix](references/audit-matrix.md) topics. Use [design rules](references/design-rules.md) as a dated baseline. Verify version-sensitive claims with official sources; disclose gaps.
Trace callers, wrappers, resources, and states. Separate confirmed defects from unverified risks.
Unless source-only, verify safe flows with simulator tools. Read installed `xcodebuildmcp` and `ios-app-qa` skills first. If unavailable, continue source review with manual verification steps.
Report severity, locations, evidence, impact, fixes, and acceptance steps. Disclose coverage; zero findings is valid.

governance.review_cadence: quarterly and after major Apple platform releases
